[CRITICAL] CLOSE_REQUIRED
subject: plan-0001
reason: B4_STOP_LOST_UNRESOLVED
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: A stop that was confirmed earlier was lost, and the plan did not reach a safe state (position flat and entry ended) within the allowed time after the loss was first seen (B4_STOP_LOST_UNRESOLVED).
Position: A position may be open without a stop; the position could not be read or the entry may still fill.
System already did: The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert. The stop was never placed again for this reason, and the emergency close reads the position quantity itself instead of sending a guessed one.
You must: Check the exchange position and the journal before any manual action. If the position is still open, close it or protect it yourself.
